title: In silico discovery of fructosamine-3-kinase inhibitors targeting the Nrf2-mediated antioxidant response in cancer cells: a molecular dynamics approach.
one_liner_zh: 该文通过分子对接和MD模拟筛选FN3K抑制剂，虽涉及Nrf2转录因子但核心是酶-小分子互作，非蛋白质-DNA结合体系，方法可迁移性有限。
abstract: Fructosamine-3-kinase is an enzyme responsible for deglycating the transcription factor nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor 2 (Nrf2) which regulates the expression of numerous genes involved in the cellular defence against oxidative stress. To identify inhibitors against FN3K, which may disrupt antioxidant-homeostasis in cancer cells, noncovalent docking was performed for a set of 83 ATP-mimicking kinase inhibitors, followed by flexible side-chain docking to re-confirm the trend in binding energies. Covalent docking was also performed for a set of 36 known covalent kinase inhibitors with the active site Cys150 residue. The recently reported crystal structure of Human FN3K [PDB:8UE1] was employed for docking. The pharmacokinetic and toxicological properties of the top noncovalent and covalent inhibitors were subsequently studied. Kinase inhibitors with appropriate ADMET properties that are suitable for human administration and have favourable binding energies were subjected to molecular dynamics simulations to study the stability of their protein-ligand complexes. On the basis of 110 ns MD simulations, it was concluded that trilaciclib, tucatinib and olmutinib can be considered candidate inhibitors for HsFN3K inhibition. Trilaciclib and tucatinib also showed favourable thermodynamic binding free energies of - 23.37 +/- 3.03 and - 18.36 +/- 1.83 kcal/mol respectively, as calculated via MM/PBSA method. Olmutinib displayed very stable binding as a complex with FN3K with no dramatic shifts in protein structure or having any impact on its folding. The solvation and hydration effects seen on the ATP-binding site in response to ligand-binding were also extensively studied which corresponds to efficient ligand entry. These drugs are expected to have favourable in-vitro and in-vivo activity inhibiting HsFN3K on the basis of our results. SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION: The online version contains supplementary material available at 10.1007/s40203-026-00635-2.
abstract_zh: 果糖胺-3-激酶是一种负责去糖化转录因子核因子红细胞2相关因子2（Nrf2）的酶，该转录因子调节参与细胞抵御氧化应激的众多基因的表达。为鉴定可能破坏癌细胞中抗氧化稳态的FN3K抑制剂，对一组83种ATP模拟激酶抑制剂进行了非共价对接，随后通过柔性侧链对接以重新确认结合能趋势。还对一组36种已知共价激酶抑制剂与活性位点Cys150残基进行了共价对接。对接采用了最近报道的人源FN3K晶体结构[PDB:8UE1]。随后研究了排名靠前的非共价和共价抑制剂的药代动力学和毒理学性质。具有合适ADMET特性、适合人体给药且结合能有利的激酶抑制剂被用于分子动力学模拟，以研究其蛋白质-配体复合物的稳定性。基于110 ns的MD模拟，得出结论：曲拉西利（trilaciclib）、妥卡替尼（tucatinib）和奥穆替尼（olmutinib）可被视为HsFN3K抑制的候选抑制剂。曲拉西利和妥卡替尼还显示出有利的热力学结合自由能，分别为-23.37 ± 3.03和-18.36 ± 1.83 kcal/mol，通过MM/PBSA方法计算。奥穆替尼与FN3K形成复合物时表现出非常稳定的结合，蛋白质结构无显著变化，且对其折叠无影响。还广泛研究了ATP结合位点响应配体结合时的溶剂化和水合效应，这与高效配体进入相对应。根据我们的结果，这些药物预计在抑制HsFN3K方面具有有利的体外和体内活性。补充信息：在线版本包含补充材料，可在10.1007/s40203-026-00635-2获取。
